text:
Ava: Heads-up — noticed a few accessibility + layout regressions after Console v2 tweaks. Specifically: toasts stacking at the bottom overlap table rows on narrow windows, nested modal is trapping keyboard focus, and ghost buttons lose contrast over the new blue header. Sharing quick repros and a proposal. Jon: Repro steps for the toast issue? I couldn't hit it locally. Ava: Steps: open /datasets, narrow viewport to ~768px, trigger Save then Preview quick actions. Toaster appears bottom-left and stacks on top of the table scroller — it obscures 1–2 rows. You can still click, but it hides content. GIF attached in thread. Priya: I saw this too. On VoiceOver it reads "3 new notifications" but doesn't announce each toast's content. Suggest using role="status" + aria-live="polite" for toasts. Also: consider top-right placement on desktop so it doesn't overlap primary content. Marco: We intentionally moved to bottom-left to match some mobile patterns, but agree desktop ergonomics differ. Proposal: responsive placement — bottom for <520px, top-right otherwise. Sofia: Also the gap between stacked toasts looks off. We're using --space-3 (12px) but visually it's ~6px. Feels like a token mismatch. Can we add a dedicated token like --toast-gap so spacing is explicit and not tied to content spacing tokens? Ava: Quick CSS example to propose: ``` :root { --toast-gap: 8px; /* new token */ --toast-z: 800; /* ensure above overlays but below modals */ } .toaster { display: flex; gap: var(--toast-gap); position: fixed; } /* placement rule */ .toaster.top-right { top: 16px; right: 16px; } .toaster.bottom-left { bottom: 12px; left: 12px; } ``` And for SR:
...toast content...
— polite avoids interrupting but announces new messages. AccessibilityBot: Note — role="status" with aria-live="polite" is recommended for non-interrupting inline notifications. Use assertive sparingly (it can disrupt screen reader flow). Jon: On the nested modal trap: the confirm modal from the row action steals focus and we don't restore focus to the originating row button after close. We should use the Modal API's focus-return helper or explicitly store document.activeElement before opening and restore on close. Priya: I'll take toast placement + aria changes and add an e2e with VO/VoiceOver and NVDA checks for announcing content. Can we aim for a PR today? Marco: I'll own the token rename and add an alias for --space-3 -> --toast-gap for one release so consumers aren't broken. I'll update the tokens docs and changelog. Ava: :thumbsup: Thanks. Also can we run a visual regression for the table sticky header? It currently adds a 1px shadow that visually eats the row separator — looks like border collapsed into the header. Sofia: Filing a tiny issue with screenshots and repro steps: https://go/repo/issue/6789 — will link PRs there. Jon: If Priya wants pairing on the screen reader test, ping me and I can help with the VoiceOver scripting. Priya: :raised_hands: Will do. I'll open the PR and tag everyone in the issue. Expected diff: placement conditional, aria updates, token + alias, modal focus restore. Ava: Awesome — thanks all. Let's land the accessibility bits first, then the visual tweaks.
